blocks.text: Travel to the Bolivian border to begin a two-day 4×4 trip with an English-speaking guide. Today's route takes in Laguna Verde and views of Licancabur, the Dalí Desert, the Polques hot springs, Sol de Mañana and Laguna Colorada. Spend the night at an expedition-style hotel in the desert. Sections of the route are above 4,000 m, where altitude sickness can occur.

3 November 2026. Head for the Bolivian border to begin your 4×4 tour. The surrounding landscapes include Laguna Verde and sweeping views of Licancabur volcano. You'll drive through the Dalí Valley with its striking rock formations, pass the Polques hot springs and see the active geysers and erupting mud pools at Sol de Mañana. The next stop is Laguna Colorada, a red lake at 4,400 m above sea level in Bolivia. The rare James's flamingo comes to the lake to feed on a type of plankton found here in abundance.
Spend the night at an expedition-style hotel in the desert.
Sections of the route are above 4,000 m, where altitude sickness can occur.

4 November 2026. After breakfast, head toward the smaller lagoons of Honda, Chiar Kkota, Hedionda and Cañapa, stopping at the Ollagüe Volcano viewpoint. The volcano is still active, and you can see a plume rising from its crater. Continue to the Chiguana Salt Flats, known for their unusual deposits of sodium and potassium nitrates.
Next comes the Salar de Uyuni, the world's largest dried salt lake. It lies on a high plateau in southern Bolivia at an elevation of 3,650 m and covers around 11,000 km². The salt crust is up to 10 m thick at the center. In the dry season it forms a vast salt desert, with reserves estimated at around 10 billion tonnes. In the rainy season a shallow layer of water turns the salt flat into the world's largest mirror.
On the way to the Salar de Uyuni, see how salt is extracted and processed in Colchani. Then visit the Ojos de Agua to see geological formations and observe salt processing. On Isla del Pescado, you'll see giant cacti and take in views of the salt flat. A boxed lunch is included.
Transfer to Uyuni after the tour.
